name: dollarzing-engine
description: Simulation engine and CLI tools for DollarZing financial gaming platform

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run type-check && esbuild src/index.ts cli/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:commander --external:node:* --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.js
scripts.build:engine: npm run clean && npm run type-check:engine && esbuild src/index.ts cli/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:commander --external:node:* --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.js
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run test-game
